about.title: About
about.name: Edgar Alan Zanin
about.bio1: Based in the beautiful coastal city of Porto, Portugal, I've dedicated my life to fitness, endurance sports, and helping others achieve their peak performance potential. As a certified personal trainer and experienced triathlete, I bring both professional knowledge and practical experience to my training programs.
about.bio2: My journey began with a passion for running, which evolved into competitive racing and eventually led me to complete the challenging Ironman 70.3. I understand the dedication, discipline, and mental fortitude required to push your limits and achieve seemingly impossible goals.

services.title: My
services.subtitle: Comprehensive fitness and performance coaching tailored to your individual goals and needs.

strength.title: Strength Training
strength.description: Customized strength programs for all fitness levels, focusing on proper form and progressive overload principles.

endurance.title: Endurance Coaching
endurance.description: Specialized training for runners, cyclists, and triathletes looking to improve stamina and race performance.

hiit.title: HIIT & Conditioning
hiit.description: High-intensity interval training sessions designed to maximize calorie burn and improve cardiovascular fitness.

race.title: Race Preparation
race.description: Comprehensive training plans for upcoming races, from 5K to marathon and triathlon events.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Fitness?
cta.description: I offer personalized 1-on-1 training sessions both in-person in Porto and online for clients worldwide. Every program is custom-designed to fit your specific goals, fitness level, and schedule.

achievements.title: My
achievements.subtitle: Personal records and competitive achievements that demonstrate my dedication to fitness and endurance sports.

fullIronman.title: Full Ironman Finisher
fullIronman.description: Completed the ultimate endurance challenge - a full Ironman triathlon consisting of a 3.8 km swim, 180 km bike ride, and a full 42.2 km marathon run.

ironman.title: Ironman 70.3 Finisher
ironman.description: Completed the challenging half Ironman distance triathlon, consisting of a 1.9 km swim, 90 km bike ride, and 21.1 km run.

marathon.title: Sub-3 Hour Marathon
marathon.description: Finished a full marathon in under 3 hours (2:56:09), an achievement that puts me in the top percentile of marathon runners worldwide.

podiums.title: Multiple Podium Finishes
podiums.description: Achieved numerous top-3 finishes in local and regional running events across various distances.

personalBests.title: Running Personal Bests
personalBests.quote: Every personal best represents countless hours of training, discipline, and determination. I bring this same dedication to helping my clients achieve their fitness goals.
